meta.title: Who Owns the Number
meta.subtitle: A history of the US advertising market, read through one question.
meta.purpose: Renders the 'sources under each paragraph' layer for P2 v2. Resolves each claim to the paragraph that carries its numbers/entities.
meta.provenance_notice: This apparatus records PROVENANCE, not verification. No claim has been verified. Human verification status: none. Grades (A/B/C) and confidence intervals are the sources' own and are preserved verbatim.

ownership_legend.cyan: INDEPENDENT — a number produced/held by a third party (audit, disclosed public figure, census, court finding of fact, regulator-extracted number)
ownership_legend.amber: SELLER-OWNED / JUDGED-PARTY — a number owned by the party being judged (the seller's self-count, the platform's own log/auction)
ownership_legend.neutral: ZINC — neutral scaffolding with no ownership claim (a GDP base, a raw span, an axis, a total used only as a denominator, a structural M&A/state-action figure)
ownership_legend.note: Per DESIGN §4.2, a seller-owned number surfaced by a court/audit KEEPS its amber owner-color; independent surfacing renders as a separate cyan overlay, not a recolor. Grade rides jitter + a mono badge, never color.

meta.grade_device: jitter amplitude ∝ grade: A = still, B = faint, C = visible shimmer (DESIGN §5).

coverage.unmapped_note: Every unmapped paragraph is scaffolding, an author's-reading passage, or a DEAD-legend statement that makes no independent numeric claim — none is an unsourced figure.
coverage.figures_note: All 7 figures are sourced by claims present in their own beats: fig1-hero (e6-measurement-006, e1-measurement-002) at s0/s14; fig5-commission-slope (e4-pricing-001, e6-creators-002) at s5; fig7-buyer-meter (e6-buyers-008, e1-buyers-008, e3-buyers-001) at s7; fig6-take-rate (mech-tac-003) at s10; fig2-instrument-blind (e6-medium-006) and fig3-medium-bank (e2-medium-006, e4-medium-002, e7-medium-001) at s12; fig4-gdp-strip (e2-scale-004, e2-scale-005, e7-scale-002) at s13.
